name: manual_4a3f80
claim: Treat a mirrored-policy check as three parts: the launch-path differential (automated, shared digest), a config-file comparison and a pin-document comparison (manual audit across both repos until a script can read both). Passing the differential alone does not show the repos agree.

decisions.notes: Supersedes lesson_0eec25ad2d50, narrowed to what the evidence supports. Evidence: PT#465 and orama-system#440 added the gpt-5.6-terra path (1,764 to 2,058 cases, digest 1cc81a58 in both repos); the config and pin-document drift (Terra row, Alexandria tip, row-driven ungated check) was found by a manual diff of the two repos, not by the differential.
